links.outcome: Readability (FRES) and actionability of LLM responses for head and neck cancer patient questions
links.effect: Median FRES ≤ 40.2 (complex language); median PEMAT-actionability ≤ 40; PEMAT-understandability median ≥ 75.0.
links.quote: LLMs were understandable (median PEMAT-understandability scores ≥ 75.0), but provided limited specific guidance (median PEMAT-actionability scores ≤ 40) and used complex language (median FRES ≤ 40.2).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance, readability, quality, and misinformation risk of eight different LLMs answering patient questions regarding oral health concerns in head and neck cancer, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
